content:
The 2014 Dow Corning Tennis Classic was a professional women's tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was part of the ITF Women's Circuit, which is a tier below the main WTA Tour. The 2014 event marked the 20th edition of the tournament, held at the Midland Community Tennis Center in Midland, Michigan, United States. The tournament took place from February 9 to February 16, 2014.

The Dow Corning Tennis Classic is known for providing up-and-coming tennis players an opportunity to compete in professional tennis and gain world ranking points. The 2014 event drew several players who were looking to boost their careers and rankings.

In terms of results, Heather Watson of Great Britain won the singles title by defeating Ksenia Pervak of Russia in the final. Watson's win marked a significant victory in her career, emphasizing her potential as a player to watch in the following seasons.

Doubles competition was also fiercely contested. The team of Sharon Fichman and Maria Sanchez claimed the title in the doubles event, showcasing their skills and teamwork throughout the tournament.

The tournament is well-regarded for its community involvement and has been a staple in the region, combining high-level tennis with local engagement to promote the sport in the area.
